items.title: [2026-07-03] List your service free — monsoon is your busy season (Image Prompt)
items.content:
Editorial magazine hero poster for QckServe, local-services theme.

SCENE: A warm, real Indian setting during monsoon — a confident local tradesperson (an electrician or plumber) in a clean work shirt standing in a doorway with a modest tool bag, light rain on the street behind, an unhurried in-demand mood; a homeowner just out of frame welcoming them in.
SUBJECT: The tradesperson mid-stride answering a call on their phone — the everyday moment of a job coming in direct.
PHONE-UI MOCKUP: A smartphone in the lower-right showing the QckServe services listing screen — a provider card with a photo, a trade label ('Electrician'), a visible 'Call' button and a small badge '0% commission'. Clean, modern app UI.
COLOUR SYSTEM: flat colour blocking, NO gradients — QckServe orange #ef6723 as the hero accent, deep charcoal #1A1A1A for contrast blocks, warm off-white paper #FCF9F8 as base, soft highlight #FFE7D8. One accent used sparingly.
LIGHTING: soft, diffused monsoon daylight, gentle shadows, cosy and trustworthy.
TYPE HIERARCHY: oversized extra-bold condensed caps headline 'YOUR BUSY SEASON.' with a smaller Georgia-italic kicker 'the monsoon rush'; a three-column editorial proof strip reading '₹0 TO LIST | 0% COMMISSION | 1:1 DIRECT'.
EYE FLOW: top-left logo zone → oversized headline → three-column proof strip → phone UI → wordmark 'qckserve.in' bottom.
CAMERA: 35mm editorial, shallow depth of field, eye-level, magazine-cover crispness.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: high thumb-stopping contrast, legible at small sizes, message reads even when compressed.
